name: Ausfernerland Ferienwohnungen
beschreibung: The Ausfernerland Ferienwohnungen inn is located in the municipality of Bach in the Reutte district. The accommodation blends the warm tradition of an inn with the comfort of holiday apartments. Its location in the Lechtal valley offers guests easy access to hiking and cycling paths. The house features a traditional dining parlor where regional cuisine is served. The holiday apartments are equipped with a kitchenette and dining area, while the inn's guest rooms also provide a cozy retreat. The surrounding area is equally suited for active holidaymakers and those seeking relaxation. The inn places great value on Tyrolean hospitality and a comfortable stay.
